facts.claim: Crown Princess (Princess Cruises): Entered service 2006; 113,561 GT; 3090 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 290 m length; Crown class.
A crown prince or hereditary prince is the heir apparent to the throne in a royal or imperial monarchy.
The female form of the title, crown princess, is held by a woman who is heir apparent or is married to the heir apparent.

catalogSpecs.description: Operated by Princess Cruises; entered service 2006; 130,000 GT; approx. 3,090 guests at double occupancy.
